Game Overview

Johnny the Worm puts players into a animal experience centered on guide Johnny the Worm through a maze, munching on apples to grow longer in this charming pixel adventure. Navigate carefully, as every gobble makes maneuvering trickier. Test your skills, avoid collisions, and aim for a record-length worm in this addictive and nostalgic journey.

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Johnny the Worm is easy to pick up. Guide Johnny the Worm through a maze, munching on apples to grow longer in this charming pixel adventure. Navigate carefully, as every gobble makes maneuvering trickier. Test your skills, avoid collisions, and aim for a record-length worm in this addictive and nostalgic journey.
